xuejiang-sp-group-tip: Special effect settings for the 雪降り、メリクリ chart (enabled by file name)
baoying-sp-group-tip: HUD texture settings for the Retribution SP chart (enabled by file name, uses RetriSP)
resolution-tip: Output resolution; render time mostly scales with the pixel count
fps-tip: Output frame rate; higher looks smoother and renders slower
hw-accel-tips: Use GPU encoding for better performance
hevc-tips: Use HEVC encoding, which has higher compression rate and slower speed
video-encoder-tip: Video encoder; hardware ones (nvenc/qsv/amf) are much faster
encoder-list: Compatibility - AVC/H.264,High Compression - HEVC/H.265,Fast - MPEG4 (Not Recommended)
sample-count-tips: Power of two above 1 turns on MSAA; forced off when frame keeping is on
fxaa-tips: FXAA is cheap but blurs the picture; best left off
bitrate-crf-tip: Range 1-51, the smaller the value, the higher the quality
output-ref-0:
Reference:
-Small File Size - Discord etc.
  Resolution: 720P
  Encoder: HEVC,
  Quality: 40
  (Click to apply)
output-ref-1:
Reference:
-High Quality - Bilibili etc.
  Resolution: 1600P
  FPS: 120
  Encoder: HEVC,
  Quality: 24
  Lossless Audio: On
  (Click to apply)
respack-missing-tip: Pack unusable: put the complete zip into the respack folder, then refresh
respack-incomplete-tip: Pack is missing files: {files}; re-download, drop into respack, refresh
aggressive-chart-tips: Skips off-screen notes for speed; some charts may look wrong
aggressive-note-tips: Hides overlapping notes for speed; some notes may vanish
aggressive-particle-tips: Hides overlapping particles for speed; some may look wrong
speed-tip: Chart speed multiplier; chart and music both speed up, so does the video length
ending-length-tip: Extra seconds rendered after the chart ends, as trailing blank
render-loading-tip: Render the official loading screen (jacket, title, difficulty) at the start
chart-debug-line-tip: Judge line debug text size; above 0 a gear picks which fields show
chart-debug-line-field-ulp-tip: Warns after the height when speed is so high that float precision runs out
chart-debug-line-field-kind-tip: Content of text / image / GIF / paint lines
chart-debug-line-field-rot-tip: Rotation of the judge line this frame, in degrees
chart-debug-note-tip: Note debug text size; above 0 a gear picks which fields show
chart-debug-note-field-angle-tip: Rotation of the judge line this frame, in degrees
xuejiang-sp-burst-combo-tip: Where the second act starts: swaps the difficulty text and rolls the score back to real
xuejiang-sp-fake-notes-tip: Fake-stage score = COMBO ÷ this value × total score
xuejiang-sp-fake-bar-seconds-tip: Seconds for the fake-stage progress bar to fill at a steady rate
xuejiang-sp-roll-scale-tip: Roll window = gap between two neighbouring notes × this factor
xuejiang-sp-volume-percentile-tip: Which loudness percentile counts as a full bar (0~1)
xuejiang-sp-volume-gamma-tip: Exponent applied to loudness: 1 = linear, 2 = squared
xuejiang-sp-volume-smooth-tip: Smoothing of the volume bar in seconds; smaller follows closer
xuejiang-sp-diff-fake-tip: Difficulty text shown at bottom right during the faked stage
xuejiang-sp-diff-real-tip: Difficulty text shown at bottom right after the reveal
xuejiang-sp-face-hit-start-tip: Hit time of the first face round in seconds; here it is note 1888
xuejiang-sp-face-period-tip: Interval between the four face rounds (s); 16 beats at 234 BPM
xuejiang-sp-face-rounds-tip: How many rounds swap the combo counter for a face; 0 disables it
xuejiang-sp-face-lead-show-tip: Seconds before the hit that the show face appears (3.5897)
xuejiang-sp-face-lead-roll-tip: Seconds before the hit that the face switches to rolling
xuejiang-sp-face-text-show-tip: Text shown at the combo position while the note just appeared
xuejiang-sp-face-text-roll-tip: Text shown at the combo position once the note starts rolling
xuejiang-sp-face-text-hit-tip: Text shown at the combo position when the note is judged
baoying-sp-wow-height-tip: Height of the WOW! sprite at the top left
baoying-sp-wow-offset-x-tip: Move the WOW! sprite to the right
baoying-sp-title-height-tip: Height of the song-title sprite at the bottom left
baoying-sp-title-offset-x-tip: Move the song-title sprite to the right
baoying-sp-score-offset-x-tip: Move the score to the right
baoying-sp-score-height-tip: Height of one score digit at the top right
baoying-sp-score-gap-tip: Spacing between score digits at the top right
baoying-sp-score-squeeze-tip: Horizontal squeeze of score digits (1 keeps the original ratio)
baoying-sp-combo-offset-x-tip: Move the combo number to the right
baoying-sp-combo-height-tip: Height of one combo digit at the top center
baoying-sp-combo-gap-tip: Spacing between combo digits at the top center
baoying-sp-combo-label-height-tip: Height of the COMBO sprite under the combo number
baoying-sp-combo-label-offset-x-tip: Move the COMBO sprite to the right
baoying-sp-combo-label-offset-tip: Spacing between the COMBO sprite and the combo number
baoying-sp-diff-height-tip: Height of the SP LV.? sprites at the bottom right
baoying-sp-diff-gap-sp-lv-tip: Spacing between the SP and LV. sprites
baoying-sp-diff-gap-lv-question-tip: Spacing between the LV. and ? sprites
baoying-sp-diff-squeeze-tip: Horizontal squeeze of the difficulty sprites
baoying-sp-diff-offset-x-tip: Move the difficulty sprites to the right
baoying-sp-digits-rtl-tip: Lays score and combo digits out right to left, as the game does
baoying-sp-hit-fx-scale-tip: Scale of the hit-effect sprite (0 keeps the value from the resource pack)
baoying-sp-hit-fx-rotate-tip: Rotates hit effects with the judge line (the game keeps them upright)
baoying-sp-particle-count-tip: Number of hit particles (0 draws no particles)
baoying-sp-switches-tip: "Digits reversed" and "Rotate hit effect" live here
jingluan-sp-group-tip: Illustration settings for the Spasmodic SP chart (enabled by file name, uses spas)
jingluan-sp-chan-height-tip: Illustration height as a screen height fraction (1 = full)
jingluan-sp-chan-offset-y-tip: Vertical offset, positive is down, as a screen height fraction
jingluan-sp-chan-fade-in-tip: Seconds the illustration takes to fade in (0 = appears instantly)
jingluan-sp-chan-fade-out-tip: Seconds the illustration takes to fade out (0 = disappears instantly)
jingluan-sp-guang-height-tip: Height of the centered illustration as a fraction of the screen height
jingluan-sp-guang-offset-y-tip: Vertical offset, positive is down, as a screen height fraction
jingluan-sp-guang-fade-in-tip: Seconds the illustration takes to fade in
jingluan-sp-guang-fade-out-tip: Seconds the illustration takes to fade out
jingluan-sp-mopemope-height-tip: Height of the centered illustration as a fraction of the screen height
jingluan-sp-mopemope-offset-y-tip: Vertical offset, positive is down, as a screen height fraction
jingluan-sp-mopemope-fade-in-tip: Seconds the illustration takes to fade in
jingluan-sp-mopemope-fade-out-tip: Seconds the illustration takes to fade out
jingluan-sp-dim-tip: How much the illustration is dimmed: 0 = none, 1 = black
mopemope-sp-group-tip: Red overlay settings for the もぺもぺ SP chart (enabled by file name)
mopemope-sp-color-a-tip: Red used for the flashes, hex like #694D24
mopemope-sp-color-b-tip: Red used for the long shots, darker than the first, like #573B0F
rr-group-tip: Hit effect colour, size and animation speed for the Rrhar'il chart
clock-paradox-sp-group-tip: Clock face settings for the Clock Paradox chart (enabled by file name)
clock-paradox-sp-scale-tip: 1 matches the reference recording; larger covers more of the screen
clock-paradox-sp-offset-x-tip: Horizontal shift of the clock centre in px at 1920 width; positive is right
clock-paradox-sp-offset-y-tip: Vertical shift of the dial centre in px at 1080 height; up is positive
clock-paradox-sp-flash1-on-tip: When the 1 dial appearance begins (chart time, seconds); it cuts in instantly
clock-paradox-sp-flash1-fade-tip: The 1 appearance starts fading out here and is gone about 0.44 s later
clock-paradox-sp-flash2-on-tip: When the 2 dial appearance begins (chart time, seconds); it cuts in instantly
clock-paradox-sp-flash2-fade-tip: The 2 appearance starts fading out here and is gone about 0.44 s later
clock-paradox-sp-flash3-on-tip: When the 3 dial appearance begins (chart time, seconds); it cuts in instantly
clock-paradox-sp-flash3-fade-tip: The 3 appearance starts fading out here and is gone about 0.44 s later
clock-paradox-sp-flash4-on-tip: When the 4 dial appearance begins (chart time, seconds); it cuts in instantly
clock-paradox-sp-flash4-fade-tip: The 4 appearance starts fading out here and is gone about 2.2 s later
qzkago-sp-group-tip: Full-screen glitch flashes for the QZKago chart (enabled by file name)
qzkago-sp-white-in-tip: Seconds for the final white flash to reach full white
qzkago-sp-white-out-tip: Seconds for the white flash to fade out
rr-hit-fx-color-tip: Overrides the hit effect colour; blank uses the sprite colour
rr-hit-fx-scale-tip: Multiplies the pack size: 1 = original, 2 = twice as large
rr-hit-fx-speed-tip: Multiplies the pack animation speed: 1 = as is, 2 = twice as fast
judge-mode-tip: Judgement mode: all Perfect, force Good, or force Bad
watermark-tip: Small translucent text centered at the bottom of the screen; empty draws nothing
roman-tip: Show score, combo and result numbers as Roman numerals
chinese-tip: Show score, combo and result numbers as Chinese numerals
multi-lang-gate-tip: Reveals the two mode switches below; only affects the UI
combo-tip: Small text under the combo; blank hides it
solid-bg-tip: Six hex digits (e.g. #FFFFFF) fill the whole screen with that colour; blank uses the chart's own background image
difficulty-tip: Difficulty shown in the loading block; blank takes it from the chart
judgeOffset-tip: Judgement timing offset in ms; positive is later, negative earlier
file-name-format-tip:
supports variables (use the real field name; * is not a wildcard):
 %date%   date YYYY-MM-DD
 %time%   time HH-MM-SS
 %file%   source file name without extension
 %level_prefix%   difficulty prefix (e.g. IN)
 %info.xxx%   chart info, replace xxx with a field name, e.g. %info.name%, %info.charter%
 %config.xxx%   render config, replace xxx with a field name, e.g. %config.fps%, %config.resolution%
unknown variables are kept as-is
render-line-extra-tips: Whether text, image, GIF and paint judge lines are drawn
render-ui-level-tip: Show the full difficulty text or just the level label
render-ui-bar-tip: The chart progress bar at the very top of the screen (with a white marker on the right)
render-background-tip: Draw the jacket background; off leaves a plain black screen
background-dim-tip: Opacity of the black background mask (0~1)
preserve-framebuffer-tips: Keeps every frame so trails grow longer; mutually exclusive with background
touch-sim-tip: Uses a synthetic finger and real judgement; leaving the spot breaks the streak
touch-sim-width-tip: Spot radius, also the break rule; 0 follows the judge range
render-particle-square-tip: The square shards spreading out in hit effects
hit-fx-random-flip-tip: Flips hit effect sprites by 180° at random
hit-fx-follow-rotation-tip: Whether hit effects rotate together with the judge line
pure-config-chart-tip: Flattens judge line animation, keeping only note x positions
pure-config-chart-line-y-tip: Height the judge lines are pinned to: 0 bottom, 1 top
pure-config-chart-speed-tip: Note fall speed and Hold tail length both derive from it
pure-config-chart-side-lines-tip: Notes heading vertically go to the two side judge lines
pure-config-chart-side-x-tip: Distance of the side lines from the screen edges: 0.5 = centre
pure-config-chart-angle-tip: Degrees within horizontal that still count as sideways notes
pure-config-chart-noise-tip: Draws a noise rectangle around notes that fall inside noise areas
pure-config-chart-noise-height-tip: Rectangle height as a screen height fraction: 0.1 = a tenth
pure-config-chart-noise-width-tip: Half width of the rectangle (screen height fraction ÷ 10)
pure-config-chart-noise-time-tip: The rectangle only shows once a note is within this many seconds of its judge time
pure-config-chart-noise-delay-tip: How long the rectangle lingers after the note has been judged
fixed-lane-chart-tip: Snaps every note onto fixed lanes and flattens the whole chart onto one line
fixed-lane-gap-tip: Distance between two neighbouring lanes, as a screen width fraction
fixed-lane-speed-tip: Fall speed multiplier; higher falls faster (tails use it too)
fixed-lane-interval-tip: Minimum seconds between two notes on a lane; otherwise the next lane out
fixed-lane-hold-length-tip: Draws Hold bodies at full length; off leaves only a stub, judgement unchanged
fixed-lane-third-tip: Whether a third lane is used when two lanes overflow
play-split-view-tip: Play two windows side by side: original chart left, modified chart right
chart-mod-replace-tip: Each of the four note types can be swapped for another; Holds get a short body
chart-mod-replace-row-tip: What this note type becomes; picking itself leaves it unchanged
chart-mod-random-tip: Picks one of the four note types at random for every note, from a fixed seed
chart-mod-random-speed-tip: Multiplies each note speed by a random factor; timing unchanged
chart-mod-random-speed-max-tip: Largest multiplier: 1 = unchanged, 2 = twice as fast
chart-mod-spread-hold-tip: Splits every Hold into a run of notes at a fixed interval; other types untouched
chart-mod-spread-hold-note-type-tip: Note type the split notes become (TAP/DRAG/HOLD/FLICK)
chart-mod-extend-hold-tip: Stretches every Hold tail nearly to the end of the music
chart-mod-extend-hold-blank-tip: Seconds before the music end where the tail stops
chart-mod-copy-tip: Copies every note several times, each copy judged on its own
chart-mod-copy-times-tip: Total copies after the operation: 1 = unchanged, 2 = every note becomes two
chart-mod-copy-offset-tip: Total span the copies spread over, centred on the note
chart-mod-hide-tip: Draws no notes at all while judgement runs as usual
chart-mod-random-pos-tip: Scatters note x positions at random; judge lines stay put
chart-mod-random-pos-range-tip: Maximum horizontal offset; half the screen width is 1
chart-mod-fixed-speed-tip: Pins the whole chart to one flow speed; the chart's own speed events stop applying
chart-mod-fixed-speed-value-tip: Same scale as the pure-config chart; higher falls faster
chart-mod-arrange-tip: Collects the whole chart on one line, one lane per note type
chart-mod-arrange-gap-tip: Lane spacing; lanes sit at ±gap and ±3×gap
chart-mod-arrange-speed-tip: Speed multiplier on the base line; larger means notes fall faster
render-extra-tips: Whether the chart's own extra.json shaders and videos are loaded
render-block-area-tips: The blockAreaList noise effect from Phigros 4.0
block-area-spark-tip: The spark dots drifting with the noise in full noise areas
block-area-hover-tip: A glow follows the finger on the noise and that area blocks hits
block-area-hover-radius-tip: Glow radius, 0.5 officially; larger covers more
block-area-noise-blotch-tip: The noise blotches mixed into the fill colour
block-area-displace-strength-tip: How far the noise pushes the sampled coordinates; 0.15 officially
block-area-pixel-scale-tip: Pixel grain size of the scene snapshot; 6 officially
block-area-displace-speed-tip: How fast the noise drifts inside the area; 1.5 officially
block-area-noise-radius-tip: Sampling radius of the noise texture; 0.48 officially
block-area-noise-smoothness-tip: Noise smoothness, 1 officially; smaller gives sharper grain
block-area-edge-noise-tip: Jagged edge strength, 1 officially; 0 gives clean straight edges
simplified-block-area-tips: Fills the noise rectangle with a flat colour, no noise, outline or sparks
simplified-block-area-text-tip: Prints the noise index (from 1) in the middle of a simplified noise area
block-area-reuse-tip: Identical noise areas that differ only in time share one index
block-area-lava-tip: Replaces the noise fill with netherrack and lava textures
water-screen-tip: Covers the screen with water and enables note HP: empty HP is a Miss
water-flow-speed-tip: Downward water speed in screen heights per second
water-cell-scale-tip: One water cell is screen height ÷ this
water-drown-delay-tip: Seconds after a note enters the water before it starts losing HP
water-damage-tip: HP lost on each damage tick while the note is on screen
water-death-time-tip: How long the red, tilted fade-out lasts after death
water-death-particles-tip: White particles spawned when a note dies
water-sfx-volume-tip: Volume of the hurt and death sounds (0~1)
ui-level-tip: UI level; higher reveals more options
direct-block-hollow-tip: In simplified noise areas the hollow blocks are covered straight over
block-area-force-position-tip: Covers the screen with noise and cuts a hole around every note
block-area-force-show-tip: Also paints the cut-out rectangles so their position is easy to check
block-area-force-time-tip: Only notes due within this many seconds get a hole
block-area-force-delay-tip: How long the hole stays after the hit
block-area-force-invert-tip: Inverted: only the ring around the notes is drawn as noise
render-judge-range-tips: Judge range width and length, relative to screen height and width
render-double-hint-tip: Enlarges simultaneous notes and draws them differently
render-pending-note-tip: Tints the next note to be judged, drawn above noise areas
pending-note-color-tip: Hex colour for the next-note tint; blank means red
dynamic-bitrate-control-tip: On = encode by quality, off = encode at a fixed bitrate
max-particles-tip: Maximum hit effects shown at the same time
render-start-time-tip: Second of the music to start rendering at; 0 = the start
render-end-time-tip: Second to stop at; blank = the end of the audio
fade-tip: Fade distance; half the screen is 1.0
alpha-tint-tip: Tints notes by alpha: up to 0.5 blue, above 0.5 red
judge-range-time-tip: Seconds before the hit that the judge range appears
judge-range-alpha-tip: Opacity the judge range is shown at (0~1)
judge-range-transition-tip: Seconds before the hit that the judge range fades in
judge-range-width-tip: Tap and Hold judge range half width = this × (screen height / 10)
judge-range-width-flick-tip: Flick and Drag judge range half width; 2.1 officially
judge-range-noise-occlusion-tip: The part overlapping noise areas is left to the noise
judge-range-length-tip: Length along the judging direction, in screen widths
block-area-alpha-tip: Fill opacity; below 1 an outline is drawn automatically
block-area-normal-color-tip: Hue of full noise areas; red means unchanged
block-area-color-tip: Fill colour of simplified noise areas once enabled
simplified-block-area-text-pale-color: Simplified Block Area Text Pale Color
block-area-density-tip: Grain density along the noise edge; larger is finer
block-area-distort-tip: Off stops the distortion, leaving flat colour or a snapshot
